panels.title: Cuello de botella ahora
panels.description: El recurso más cerca de su límite en el último muestreo (sin contar temperatura ni el núcleo más cargado). Si ninguno pasa del 50 % muestra 'Nada cerca del límite'.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ts AS time,
  CASE WHEN bottleneck_pct >= 50 THEN bottleneck ELSE 'Nada cerca del límite' END AS metric, bottleneck_pct AS value
FROM poll WHERE ts = (SELECT max(ts) FROM poll)

SELECT ts AS time, resource AS metric, pct AS value FROM resource_sample
WHERE ts = (SELECT max(ts) FROM resource_sample) ORDER BY pct DESC

panels.title: Ocupación p95 en el periodo
panels.description: El 95 % del tiempo la ocupación estuvo por debajo de este valor. Es mejor indicador que el pico para planificar.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT max(ts) AS time, resource AS metric, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY pct) AS value
FROM resource_sample WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY resource ORDER BY 3 DESC

panels.title: Ocupación por recurso
panels.description: % de su capacidad. Amarillo a partir de 70 %, rojo a partir de 85 %.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts, '1m'), resource AS metric, max(pct) AS value
FROM resource_sample WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Episodios de cuello de botella (ocupación >= umbral)
panels.description: Cada fila es un tramo seguido en el que un recurso estuvo por encima del umbral: qué recurso, cuánto duró, quién estaba viendo y qué más estaba cargado.

targets.rawSql:
WITH hot AS (
  SELECT ts, bottleneck, bottleneck_pct, playing, transcodes,
    CASE WHEN lag(ts) OVER (PARTITION BY bottleneck ORDER BY ts) >= ts - make_interval(secs => 2.5 * $poll) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS brk
  FROM poll WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND bottleneck_pct >= $crit
), g AS (
  SELECT *, sum(brk) OVER (PARTITION BY bottleneck ORDER BY ts) AS grp FROM hot
)
SELECT min(g.ts) AS "Inicio",
  round(extract(epoch FROM max(g.ts) - min(g.ts)) / 60 + $poll / 60.0, 1) AS "Minutos",
  g.bottleneck AS "Cuello de botella",
  round(max(g.bottleneck_pct)::numeric) AS "Pico %",
  max(g.playing) AS "Streams", max(g.transcodes) AS "Transcodes",
  (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT s.user_name || ' (' || coalesce(s.video_decision, '?') || ')', ', ')
     FROM session_sample s WHERE s.ts BETWEEN min(g.ts) AND max(g.ts) AND s.state = 'playing') AS "Quién estaba viendo",
  (SELECT c.name || ' ' || round(avg(c.cpu_pct)::numeric) || '% CPU'
     FROM container_sample c WHERE c.ts BETWEEN min(g.ts) AND max(g.ts)
     GROUP BY c.name HAVING avg(c.cpu_pct) >= 1 ORDER BY avg(c.cpu_pct) DESC LIMIT 1) AS "Contenedor que más CPU usaba",
  (SELECT string_agg(r.resource || ' ' || round(r.pct::numeric) || '%', ', ' ORDER BY r.pct DESC)
     FROM resource_sample r WHERE r.ts = max(g.ts) AND r.pct >= 50 AND r.resource <> g.bottleneck) AS "Otros recursos >50%"
FROM g GROUP BY g.bottleneck, g.grp ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Margen: cuántos streams más caben
panels.description: Estimación: consumo medio con streams menos consumo en reposo, dividido entre streams (para la GPU, entre transcodes). 'Streams extra' = cuántos más caben antes de llegar al umbral partiendo del p95. El que tenga el número más bajo será el primer cuello de botella.

targets.rawSql:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT rs.resource, rs.pct, rs.capacity, rs.unit,
    CASE WHEN rs.resource LIKE 'GPU%' THEN p.transcodes ELSE p.playing END AS n
  FROM resource_sample rs JOIN poll p ON p.ts = rs.ts
  WHERE $__timeFilter(rs.ts) AND rs.resource <> 'GPU temperatura'
), s AS (
  SELECT resource, max(capacity) AS cap, max(unit) AS unit, max(pct) AS peak,
    percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY pct) AS p95,
    percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY pct) FILTER (WHERE n = 0) AS idle,
    avg(pct) FILTER (WHERE n > 0) AS busy,
    avg(n) FILTER (WHERE n > 0) AS avg_n
  FROM r GROUP BY resource
), k AS (
  SELECT *, (busy - coalesce(idle, 0)) / nullif(avg_n, 0) AS per_stream FROM s
)
SELECT resource AS "Recurso",
  trim_scale(round(cap::numeric, 1)) || ' ' || unit AS "Capacidad",
  round(p95::numeric, 1) AS "p95 %",
  round(peak::numeric, 1) AS "Pico %",
  round(per_stream::numeric, 1) AS "% por stream",
  CASE WHEN avg_n IS NULL THEN 'faltan datos con streams'
       WHEN per_stream > 0.5 THEN greatest(floor(($crit - p95) / per_stream), 0)::int::text
       ELSE 'sin límite a la vista' END AS "Streams extra que caben"
FROM k ORDER BY p95 DESC

panels.title: Especificaciones del sistema
panels.description: Lo que tiene la máquina. Se actualiza al arrancar el colector y una vez al día.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT component AS "Componente", name AS "Nombre", detail AS "Detalle",
  trim_scale(round(capacity::numeric, 2)) || ' ' || unit AS "Capacidad"
FROM system_spec ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: CPU por contenedor (% de toda la máquina)
panels.description: Los 8 contenedores que más CPU usan. Sirve para ver si otro contenedor le quita recursos a Plex.

targets.rawSql:
WITH top AS (SELECT name FROM container_sample WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY name ORDER BY avg(cpu_pct) DESC LIMIT 8)
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts, '1m'), name AS metric, avg(cpu_pct) AS value FROM container_sample
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND name IN (SELECT name FROM top) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

WITH top AS (SELECT name FROM container_sample WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY name ORDER BY avg(mem_mb) DESC LIMIT 8)
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts, '1m'), name AS metric, avg(mem_mb) * 1024 * 1024 AS value FROM container_sample
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND name IN (SELECT name FROM top) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Equidad entre usuarios: ¿reciben todos la misma calidad?
panels.description: 100 % = todos los que están viendo algo a la vez reciben la misma proporción de su calidad original. Cuanto más baja, más sale perdiendo alguien frente a los demás. Solo se calcula cuando hay 2 o más personas reproduciendo.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts, '1m'), avg(jain_quality) AS "Equidad de calidad"
FROM poll WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Ancho de banda por usuario
panels.description: Mbps que recibe cada usuario mientras reproduce.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts, '1m'), user_name AS metric, avg(bandwidth_kbps)/1000.0 AS value
FROM session_sample WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND state = 'playing'
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Calidad servida / original por usuario
panels.description: 100 % = le llega la calidad original (direct play). Si transcodifica, la proporción de bitrate que le llega.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts, '1m'), user_name AS metric, avg(quality_ratio) AS value
FROM session_sample WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND state = 'playing'
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Velocidad de transcode (<1 = cortes)
panels.description: Mínimo por minuto. Por debajo de 1x Plex no llega a tiempo y el cliente se queda cargando. No incluye los momentos en que Plex pausa el transcode porque ya va adelantado.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts, '1m'), user_name AS metric, min(transcode_speed) AS value
FROM session_sample WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND state = 'playing' AND transcode_speed > 0 AND NOT coalesce(throttled, false)
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: GPU (RTX 2060) vs transcodes
panels.description: Uso del codificador (NVENC) y decodificador (NVDEC) de la GPU junto al número de transcodes.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts, '1m'), avg(gpu_enc_util) AS "NVENC %", avg(gpu_dec_util) AS "NVDEC %",
  avg(gpu_util) AS "GPU %", max(transcodes) AS "Transcodes", max(playing) AS "Reproduciendo"
FROM poll WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Lectura por disco del array
panels.description: Si dos streams leen del mismo disco compiten entre sí: el array de Unraid no reparte los datos entre discos.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts, '1m'), disk AS metric, avg(read_mbps) AS value
FROM disk_sample WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1, 2 HAVING max(read_mbps) > 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Streams simultáneos por disco
panels.description: Disco donde está el fichero de cada stream (atributo system.LOCATION de Unraid).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts, '1m'), coalesce(disk, '?') AS metric, max(n) AS value FROM (
  SELECT ts, disk, count(*) AS n FROM session_sample
  WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND state = 'playing' GROUP BY ts, disk) x
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Resumen por usuario
panels.description: Por usuario en el periodo: horas vistas, % del tiempo con transcode, calidad media recibida, % del tiempo con transcode lento (<1x), Mbps medio y avisos de buffer.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.user_name AS "Usuario",
  round(count(*) * $poll / 3600.0, 1) AS "Horas",
  round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN s.video_decision = 'transcode' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS "% transcode",
  round(avg(s.quality_ratio)::numeric, 2) AS "Calidad media",
  round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN s.transcode_speed > 0 AND s.transcode_speed < 1 AND NOT coalesce(s.throttled, false) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS "% transcode lento",
  round(avg(s.bandwidth_kbps) / 1000.0, 1) AS "Mbps medio",
  (SELECT count(*) FROM buffer_event b WHERE b.user_name = s.user_name AND $__timeFilter(b.ts)) AS "Buffers"
FROM session_sample s WHERE $__timeFilter(s.ts) AND s.state = 'playing'
GROUP BY s.user_name ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Momentos en que alguien salió perdiendo
panels.description: Muestreos en los que la equidad bajó del umbral. El detalle muestra, por usuario: % de calidad recibida, si hacía direct play o transcode, y velocidad del transcode.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT p.ts AS "Momento", p.playing AS "Reproduciendo", round(100 * p.jain_quality)::int AS "Equidad %",
  round(p.gpu_enc_util::numeric) AS "NVENC %",
  string_agg(s.user_name || ' ' || round(100 * coalesce(s.quality_ratio, 0))::text || '% '
             || coalesce(s.video_decision, '')
             || CASE WHEN s.transcode_speed > 0 AND NOT coalesce(s.throttled, false) THEN ' x' || s.transcode_speed::text
                     WHEN s.video_decision = 'transcode' THEN ' (en pausa, va adelantado)' ELSE '' END, ' | ' ORDER BY s.quality_ratio) AS "Detalle"
FROM poll p JOIN session_sample s ON s.ts = p.ts AND s.state = 'playing'
WHERE $__timeFilter(p.ts) AND p.jain_quality < $jain_threshold
GROUP BY p.ts, p.playing, p.jain_quality, p.gpu_enc_util ORDER BY p.ts DESC LIMIT 300

panels.title: Concurrencia media por día y hora
panels.description: Media de personas reproduciendo a la vez en cada franja. La columna Pico es el máximo.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT lpad(h::text, 2, '0') || 'h' AS "Hora",
  round(avg(playing) FILTER (WHERE d = 1), 2) AS "Lun", round(avg(playing) FILTER (WHERE d = 2), 2) AS "Mar",
  round(avg(playing) FILTER (WHERE d = 3), 2) AS "Mié", round(avg(playing) FILTER (WHERE d = 4), 2) AS "Jue",
  round(avg(playing) FILTER (WHERE d = 5), 2) AS "Vie", round(avg(playing) FILTER (WHERE d = 6), 2) AS "Sáb",
  round(avg(playing) FILTER (WHERE d = 7), 2) AS "Dom", max(playing) AS "Pico"
FROM (SELECT extract(isodow FROM ts AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Madrid')::int AS d, extract(hour FROM ts AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Madrid')::int AS h, playing
      FROM poll WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)) x
GROUP BY h ORDER BY h

panels.title: Eventos de buffer
panels.description: Avisos de buffer que manda Tautulli por webhook (si lo tienes configurado).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ts AS "Momento", user_name AS "Usuario", title AS "Título" FROM buffer_event
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 200
